outcome: survival rate of infants with birth weight ≤500 g
cohort: 226 infants with birth weight ≤500 g and ≥22 weeks gestation
finding: Better neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) quality care practices, including better cardiorespiratory management, were associated with improved survival rates in infants with birth weight ≤500 g.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with improved survival in infants with birth weight ≤500 g.
